newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FNB follows Standard Bank prime rate cut.
newsitem.headline: FNB follows Standard Bank prime rate cut.

text.p: S.Africa's First National Bank Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was cutting its prime overdraft rate to 19.25 percent from 19.50, effective October 1.
The home loan rate also falls by 25 basis points to 19.00 percent from the same date.
The FNB announcement follows a similar move on Wednesday by Standard Bank Investment Corp Ltd.
Standard said its rate cut reflected the government's decision to scrap the Financial Services Levy (FSL) and replace it with value added tax (VAT) on financial services from next month.
FSL was first introduced by the South African government in 1991, when banks increased prime by 0.25 percent to recover the cost.
